mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 110.0), declining industrial output reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and spending to drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing expansion regimes (INDPRO > 115.0), strong industrial production growth supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 115.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
